math_notes.type: targeted proof check, conditional on the page’s stated At5 reformulation
math_notes.content: Assume the written restatement that ≤ and ≪ coincide inside each F̃. For X∈F̃, the written F^X={Y∈F̃ : X≪Y} equals {Y∈F̃ : X≤Y}. By reflexivity X belongs to it, and its defining condition says X≤Y for every member Y. Thus X itself is its least element. This verifies the redundancy observation for the written At6 hypothesis, not the full equivalence claimed by the page and not the author’s intended correction.

SA21-K7-01 correctly reports the written incidence hypothesis X triangleleft F and its explicit membership gloss. Its replacement X≪F is not the ink. The conditional proof above supports the concern that the written least-element condition adds nothing under the stated At5 restatement; it does not uniquely establish X≪F as the intended hypothesis. S’s scan007 reference was not consulted because only scan006 is assigned.
